scripts.check:design: npm run check:tokens && npm run check:no-raw-hex
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd microfrontends/blog && npm install && cd ../../shared && npm install
scripts.build:all: npm run build && cd microfrontends/blog && npm install && NODE_ENV=production npm run build && cd ../.. && npm run copy-blog
scripts.copy-blog: mkdir -p dist/blog && cp -r microfrontends/blog/dist/* dist/blog/ && cp microfrontends/blog/dist/sitemap.xml dist/sitemap.xml && echo 'Copy completed'
